meta.title: AI Hiring for Experienced Professionals | letshyre.ai
meta.description: Hire experienced professionals on evidence. LetsHyre ranks candidates with AI resume analysis, role-based interviews and scorecards you can check.

hero.title: See how they interview
hero.description: Every candidate takes a role-based AI interview first. Get a ranked shortlist with scores and recordings, and pay only for the people you want to meet.
hero.reassurance: 10 free credits for employers. Always free for professionals.
hero.photo: A hiring manager points at her laptop screen as she talks through a shortlist on a video call.

scene.label: A LetsHyre shortlist for a Senior frontend engineer job: four candidates ranked by AI match, each with an AI interview score. Vyshnavi Rao ranks first with an 86 match and a 78 interview, and her file is unlocked.

contrast.title: A resume tells you what someone claims.
contrast.description: Resumes are written to impress. LetsHyre interviews every candidate first, so you compare how people actually think before you spend a single call.

professionals.title: Interview once.
professionals.body: Take a role-based AI interview in the desktop app, whenever it suits you. For 90 days your scorecard sits in the talent pool, where employers hiring for your role find you.
points: Up to 3 interviews: different roles, or a retake
A skill scorecard after every interview
